purpose_context: A family of root resolvers treats a standalone clone as its own primary and re-anchors worktree working directories to the main checkout, producing silent cross-checkout writes, false-green guards, and divergent review-verdict behavior across a dozen commands. This mission fixes that shared root cause and closes the review-verdict CLI-parity gaps that ride the same seam, so a command run from a worktree or clone never silently re-anchors its write, gate check, or verdict.
purpose_tldr: Make root/workspace resolution honest under linked worktrees and standalone clones, and unify the review-verdict CLI path across both surfaces.
